newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia Dec PPI slows to 0.3 pct, 1.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Croatia Dec PPI slows to 0.3 pct, 1.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: The State Bureau of Statistics issued the following economic indicator details.
CROATIA PRODUCER PRICES DEC '96 NOVEMBER DEC '95
NOTES -- Producer prices were 0.1 percent lower between January and December 1996 than at the end of 1995. The annualised average producer price inflation was 1.4 percent last year.
Croatia introduced a radical anti-inflation programme in October 1993, when monthly producer price inflation was running at 29.1 percent.
